question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a heterogenous mixture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinegar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **heterogeneous mixture** is a mixture in which the composition is **not uniform** throughout and the different components can be observed as separate phases.
 
• **Vinegar**: It is a **homogeneous mixture** (solution) of **acetic acid** and **water**. Because the **acetic acid** dissolves completely in **water**, the mixture has a uniform appearance and composition throughout. ***Hence, this is not a heterogeneous mixture and is the correct answer.***
